messages:
Olivia_Corp: Hey team — hitting a schema validation error when calling invoice.create via tool invoke. Getting 400 with "required property 'order_id' is missing" but we sent orderId. Request ID: req_abc123. Payload below.

Maya (support): Thanks — can you paste the exact payload and time? Also which SDK version are you on?

Olivia_Corp: Payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "orderId": "ORD-2026-0123",
  "amount": 1200,
  "currency": "USD"
}
```
Also calling via our service with curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @payload.json`
We saw the error at 2026-03-15T14:12:33Z. SDK v1.2.3.

Maya (support): Hmm—looks like a camelCase vs snake_case mismatch. Our invoice.create schema expects `order_id` (snake_case) and has `additionalProperties: false` so unrecognized keys can cause validation failures. The validator reports missing required fields rather than extra keys in some flows. Can you try sending `order_id` instead?

Olivia_Corp: We can, but this is a regression — our client used to accept `orderId` (maybe the gateway did a mapping before). Need repro + root cause for escalation.

Kevin (eng-runtime): @Maya @Olivia_Corp — please paste the full invoke envelope (include the `tool`/`params` wrapper and any `metadata` you send) and the X-Request-ID header. If gateway routed to the wrong tool/version the schema could differ.

Olivia_Corp: Full invoke body (redacted headers) below:
```json
{
  "tool": "invoice.create",
  "params": {
    "orderId": "ORD-2026-0123",
    "amount": 1200,
    "currency": "USD"
  },
  "metadata": {
    "client_version": "myclient-4.5.1"
  }
}
```
Headers: `X-Request-ID: req_abc123`, `X-Route: hosted-eu`

SRE Bot: Log excerpt for req_abc123: 
`schema_validator: {"error":"required property 'order_id'","path":"/params","schema":"invoice.create.v2","additionalProperties":false,"receivedKeys":["orderId","amount","currency"]}`

Jules (oncall): Repro steps validated. Root cause: gateway no longer applies the camelCase->snake_case compatibility mapping for tool params when invoking `invoice.create.v2` (we tightened schema validation for v2 and set `additionalProperties: false`). The combination causes the validator to report `order_id` missing while also rejecting unknown top-level params.
Quick mitigation: customers can either (1) update client to send `order_id` or (2) set an invocation metadata flag `compat_keys: true` to trigger the legacy key mapping at gateway. We're patching gateway to auto-attempt camelCase->snake_case mapping for 24h while we ship a proper compatibility layer. ETA ~3h.

Maya (support): Olivia, can you try the quick test with `order_id` to confirm success so we can close your immediate blocker? We'll follow up when the fallback is in place. :thumbsup:

Olivia_Corp: Tried with `order_id` and invoke succeeded (200). Thanks — we'll schedule a client update, but please leave the fallback on until next week so our rollout window is safe.

Maya (support): Copy — leaving fallback enabled for 7 days. I'll open an internal follow-up to track adding explicit compatibility tests so this doesn't regress again. Thanks for the quick repro, team. :raised_hands:
